name: [🔥] Ability Slap Tower 3✋
desc:
Welcome to the Ability Slap Tower 3✋!
Can you climb this troll tower without getting slapped down? 🤔
Earn 100 wins 🏆 to unlock the powerful Infinity Glove🌌 .

🌀 Extra 🌀
🔐 Find the secret code in this troll obby to unlock the Diamond Glove🌟.
🚀 The Big Rainbow Glove✋ increases your attack range.
🎉Earn 15,000 Cash to buy Admin!

📍 Inspired by Slap Battles, with surprises, troll traps, and chaotic fun along the way.
(Credits: @rkdss for the standard glove template, @L0stCompass for some particle effects.)
